questions.question_text: As a Mid-Level (2-5 yrs) Full Stack Developer in Software & Technology, can you walk me through a major project where you handled React? What were the key trade-offs and business results?
questions.star_guidance: Outline the business context (Situation), your specific responsibility (Task), the technical options you evaluated and chose (Action), and quantifiable results (Result).

questions.question_text: Describe a situation in your work as a Full Stack Developer where you encountered an unexpected system failure or shifting requirement related to React. How did you prioritize and resolve it?
questions.star_guidance: Highlight how you communicated risk early to stakeholders while maintaining operational stability.

questions.question_text: What architectural patterns or best practices do you apply when scaling solutions for Full Stack Developer roles in the Software & Technology domain?
questions.star_guidance: Describe your diagnostic methodology step-by-step before diving into code or implementation choices.

questions.question_text: Tell me about a time you had a technical or process disagreement with a teammate while working on React. How did you align on a solution?
questions.star_guidance: Focus on empathy, benchmarking, prototyping, and aligning on business goals rather than winning an argument.

questions.question_text: If hired for this Full Stack Developer position, how would you approach your first 30-60-90 days to drive impact in React?
questions.star_guidance: Break down your answer into 30 days (learning & context), 60 days (first key contribution), and 90 days (leadership & optimization).

questions.question_text: As a Mid-Level (2-5 yrs) Full Stack Developer in Software & Technology, can you walk me through a major project where you led system design? What were the key architectural trade-offs, constraints, and business outcomes?
questions.star_guidance: Detail the business context (Situation), your core responsibility (Task), the exact engineering/strategy steps (Action), and key metrics achieved (Result).

questions.question_text: Describe a situation in your work as a Full Stack Developer where you encountered an unexpected system failure or shifting business requirement while implementing execution. How did you reprioritize and keep stakeholders aligned?
questions.star_guidance: Focus on early risk escalation, transparent stakeholder updates, and maintaining output quality.

questions.question_text: What production best practices, observability tools, or scaling patterns do you apply when building infrastructure for Full Stack Developer roles handling system design?
questions.star_guidance: Walk through your diagnostic methodology step-by-step before detailing implementation choices.

questions.question_text: Tell me about a time you had a strong technical disagreement with a colleague regarding design choices for execution. How did you evaluate options and reach consensus?
questions.star_guidance: Highlight active listening, prototyping/benchmarking, and focusing on business outcomes rather than winning an argument.

questions.question_text: If selected for this Full Stack Developer position, what specific milestones would you establish for your first 30, 60, and 90 days to drive value in system design?
questions.star_guidance: Break down your answer into 30 days (context & onboarding), 60 days (first major deliverable), and 90 days (process optimization & scaling).

feedback.feedback_summary: [Situation]: In my role as a Full Stack Developer, our team encountered a scenario requiring deep domain knowledge in Technical. [Task]: My responsibility was to research industry standards, identify root causes, and propose a solution. [Action]: I reviewed technical documentation, constructed a prototype, and consulted senior peers. [Result]: This resolved our project bottleneck and established a reliable template for future work.

practice_plans.title: 7-Day Improvement Plan for Full Stack Developer
practice_plans.plan_days_json: [{"day":1,"focus":"STAR Framework Refinement","action":"Draft 3 behavioral stories strictly following Situation, Task, Action, and Result headers."},{"day":2,"focus":"Metrics & Data Integration","action":"Extract 5 measurable stats from your top projects (e.g. % performance increase, scale)."},{"day":3,"focus":"Trade-off Articulation","action":"Practice answering technical design questions by explicitly stating pros/cons of selected technologies."},{"day":4,"focus":"Scenario Deep Dives","action":"Re-answer questions from this session using the improved STAR model response recommendations."},{"day":5,"focus":"Speed & Time Management","action":"Practice keeping answers under 2 minutes while maintaining high clarity."},{"day":6,"focus":"Target Role Mock Drill","action":"Execute a full 5-question mock interview session in simulated real-time mode."},{"day":7,"focus":"Final Delivery & Polish","action":"Review performance progress metrics, refine key project talking points, and boost confidence."}]
